style-token.guidance: Read exact scoped Token CSS/JSON, select styleId explicitly, and test in the destination. Do not import all styles globally.

behavior-pattern.guidance: Transfer interaction contract, state invariants, keyboard/touch alternatives and failure paths; rebuild the view for the target stack.

composition-recipe.guidance: Use a blueprint or procedure for planning; verify whether the underlying demo is static or real React before copying.

design-reference.guidance: Visual/product inspiration only; do not copy proprietary code, assets or claims. Check source/license.
